public_sources.bound_semantics: Folly documents deferred reclamation: retired objects are reclaimed only once concurrent readers can no longer be using them; currently protected retired objects are not reclaimed.
A hazard pointer protects an object from reclamation while in use; a retired object is reclaimed only after it is no longer protected.

chat_native_reduction.mapping: pending outcome token P7 acts as a role-local hazard reference to retired assignment metadata A@7
chat_native_reduction.tombstone_rule: A durable T7 tombstone preserving epoch identity, scope/provenance fingerprint, finalization marker and spent key K7 is an additional controller safety rule; it is not claimed as a hazard-pointer library feature.
chat_native_reduction.reclamation_rule: bulky A@7 metadata may be compacted only after P7 terminal-or-aborted readback clears the hazard and T7 is independently read back
